text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Tuesday:
- Swiss foreign minister Flavio Cotti and World Jewish Congress president Israel Singer met on Monday in Berne to discuss the organisation and the distribtion of a special fund for Holocaust victims.
- Austrian chancellor Viktor Klima said during his visit to Berne on Monday that he would not block the bilateral negotiations between Switzerland and the European Union.
- The Prince of Lichtenstein Hans Adam II said current anti-drug laws are useful to the drug barons. He would favour a system allowing young people above 18 to have legal access to drugs.
- Swiss Justice Minister Arnold Koller said Attorney Clara Del Ponte acted correctly when she tapped the phone calls of Swiss jounalist.
